intro: Welcome to Kalisenses. Follow the highlighted note. There is no score here.
placement: Place the kalimba on a clear, level table. On Specs, find a surface, then confirm placement. On your laptop, the virtual tabletop is ready.
choose: Choose an input method. You can change it later without losing progress.
action-physical: Press the letter printed on the amber tine. Then lift your finger off the key. Try your other hand when the caption asks.
action-virtual: Poke the amber note pad with your index finger. Then lift your finger. In the laptop preview, click a pad instead.
action-pinch: Start with your right hand. Aim at a tine. Amber shows the target. Bring your thumb and index finger together to pinch. Then open them to release. Use your left hand when the caption asks.
sequence: Now try a little sequence. Follow the amber note. There is no hurry. Every retry is welcome.
melody: Let us play Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star in C major. Play the next amber note. There is no timer. We will wait for you.
offer: You played the melody. Well done. Choose Next to finish the tutorial, or Skip to start Free Play.
complete: You made music. Keep exploring. Choose Next to open Free Play. You can replay the tutorial from the main menu.
help-physical: Take your time. Find the letter printed beneath the amber note, press it once, then lift your finger. You can replay this instruction or change input.
help-virtual: Take your time. Use your index finger to poke the amber pad. Lift before touching again. In the preview, click the pad. You can change input without losing your place.
help-pinch: Aim first. Watch for amber on the tine. Bring your thumb and index finger together, once. Open them fully before trying again. Watch the larger demonstration, or choose another input.
tracking: Your hands are not being tracked steadily. Move them into view in good light. If that is difficult, choose Input and switch to Virtual Keyboard or Physical Keyboard. Your progress is safe.
